mechanism: Trimethoprim inhibits renal tubular secretion of tranylcypromine and can increase sympathomimetic effects; tranylcypromine is an MAOI with potential for hypertensive crisis, and trimethoprim may potentiate this risk through altered clearance and increased catecholamine sensitivity.
action: Avoid concurrent use if possible; if necessary, monitor blood pressure closely, use lowest effective doses, and educate patient on dietary tyramine restriction and signs of hypertensive crisis.
